items.title: Bitcoin recovers from Asian-session lows as falling oil price supports risk appetite
items.summary: Bitcoin traded near $86,000 as WTI crude dropped below $90 and strong stock markets supported risk appetite.

items.title: ECB, EU cenbanks seek changes in MiCA’s minimum bank deposit for stablecoins
items.summary: The ECB and EU central banks want to replace MiCA’s stablecoin bank-deposit requirements with liquidity thresholds, warning that sudden withdrawals could strain lenders.

items.title: Bitcoin price tags $86K as analysis sees crypto in ‘new bull market’
items.summary: Bitcoin crossed the $86,000 mark for the first time since late January as falling oil prices and concerns over supply lifted US stocks.

items.title: Why Payward-backed Reap is betting on non-USD stablecoins for 24/7 cross-border FX settlement
items.summary: Reap is preparing to add a Mexican peso stablecoin and is exploring Hong Kong dollar, euro, won and yen tokens for foreign exchange outside banking hours.

items.title: A $3.2 million 'bitcoin butterfly' option trade bets on $95,000 by the end of October
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Sept. 22, 2026

items.title: Binance buys $100 million Circle stake in five-year USDC promotion deal
items.summary: Circle sold 1.24 million shares at $80.84 each and will pay Binance a monthly fee tied to USDC held through its wallet infrastructure.

items.title: Live updates: Oil falls as Iran signals possible Hormuz reopening, bitcoin holds near $86,000
items.summary: WTI crude oil drops to $89 as reports suggest Iran could reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days.

items.title: Binance probed by U.S. federal prosecutors for sanctions violations: Bloomberg
items.summary: Federal prosecutors in Manhattan and the Justice Department are said to be investigating whether the crypto exchange knowingly permitted users to bypass U.S. sanctions on Iran.

items.title: Animoca Brands delays IPO plans, suspends merger talks with Currenc
items.summary: Talks between the two kicked off late last year, with plans for the former to own 95% of the merged company.

items.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs attracted nearly $1 billion on Monday, the 9th largest inflow ever
items.summary: Inflows into spot bitcoin ETFs picked up Monday as bitcoin rallied to its highest since January.

items.title: Whitehats move 52 bitcoin from the Coldcard hack to a recovery trust
items.summary: According to Galaxy Digital, the good guys have moved 52 BTC to an address carrying an OP_RETURN message reading "claim:cryptorecoverytrust dot com."

items.title: Elon Musk's X brings bitcoin and stock trading closer to the timeline
items.summary: Elon Musk’s X lets U.S. users tap cashtags such as $BTC to view live charts and access Coinbase, Kraken and other trading platforms.

items.title: Dogecoin leads market rebound with 15% pump, bitcoin steady above $85,000
items.summary: A wave of forced buying that cost short sellers $844 million has run its course, leaving the largest cryptocurrency flat over the past hour and ZEC the only major token in the red.

items.title: Cardano joins Solana, XRP Ledger in race to power AI agent payments
items.summary: The official x402 kit now includes Cardano tools for apps and AI agents to pay with ADA and other network tokens, though the facilitator has so far only been tested on pre-production.

items.title: ECB to put its own money into tokenized securities via new Pontes DLT
items.summary: The ECB aims to gain firsthand DLT market experience by buying tokenized public-sector securities and settling the trades through Pontes.

items.title: Crypto metric signals altseason as Bitcoin market-cap share stalls below 60%
items.summary: Glassnode’s Altcoin Cycle Signal printed a new altseason signal after a month of Bitcoin and altcoin market-cap gains.

items.title: Crypto market cap reclaims $3 trillion as Bitcoin, altcoins rally
items.summary: Bitcoin traded near $86,000 as major altcoins gained, while rising derivatives leverage pointed to growing speculative activity across crypto markets.

items.title: White hats outrun Coldcard hackers in 52-Bitcoin evacuation
items.summary: White hats secured about 40% of the Bitcoin moved in the Coldcard exploit’s second wave, transferring it to a Wyoming trust for victims.

items.title: Crypto’s wild boom-and-bust cycles are fading, Solstice CEO says
items.summary: Solstice CEO Ben Nadareski says deeper liquidity and growing institutional participation could make future crypto bull runs less volatile than previous cycles.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs flirt with $1B as inflows hit 2026 high
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew nearly $1 billion on Monday, their largest daily inflow since October 2025, as Bitcoin briefly climbed above $87,000.
